_note: The score's validation set (blind-spot review #2). TROUBLED: a public source shows insolvency proceedings, a cancelled registration, a court takeover or long stalling. CLEAN: a large listed developer with a public delivery record and no insolvency, cancellation or court takeover found. 'Clean' is a proxy, not a claim that every project was perfect. The labels are about the developer at the time of the source, and the ShelterKart report is judged on whether it surfaces that record. Project names identify what the engine searches; the label's evidence is the source. India first, because it is the launch market; every market added later needs its own 10 and 10 (gate 6).
